name: Afterempire holdings gazetteer
use: Ownership and status of every holding shown on the Territorial Ledger.
citation: Atal, D. (2026). Afterempire: Holdings gazetteer v0.1: data/curated/holdings.csv and periods.csv. 177 holdings, 638 control periods. Trade crosswalk: data/curated/trade_codes.csv.
coverage: 1800–2025 · GBR, FRA, PRT, NLD and powers that took their holdings

name: BACI world trade (CEPII)
use: Reached through CEPII Gravity (below); not downloaded separately.
citation: Gaulier, G. and Zignago, S. (2010). BACI: International Trade Database at the Product-Level. CEPII Working Paper 2010-23.

name: CEPII Gravity database
use: Bilateral trade flows for 2015–2020 (BACI trade flow, with IMF data as fallback). 2021–2025 show 2020 as the latest available year.
citation: Conte, M., Cotterlaz, P. and Mayer, T. (2022). The CEPII Gravity Database. CEPII Working Paper 2022-05. Version V202211.

name: COLDAT: Colonial Dates Dataset
use: Cross-check of start and end dates of colonial rule (see the validation report).
citation: Becker, B. (2019). Introducing COLDAT: The Colonial Dates Dataset. Harvard Dataverse. doi:10.7910/DVN/T9SDEW.

name: Correlates of War Trade
use: Cross-check of bilateral trade totals, 1870 onward (Phase 4).
citation: Barbieri, K. and Keshk, O. Correlates of War Project Trade Data Set, version 4.

name: d3
use: Flat-map projection (Equal Earth), zoom and the loading globe.
citation: Bostock, M. et al. D3: Data-Driven Documents, version 7.9.0.

name: Federico-Tena World Trade Historical Database
use: Benchmark totals for checking nineteenth-century trade (Phase 4).
citation: Federico, G. and Tena-Junguito, A. (2016). World Trade Historical Database.

name: Garriga Central Bank Independence
use: Central bank independence dimension in Inherited Systems (Phase 5).
citation: Garriga, A. C. (2016). Central Bank Independence in the World: A New Data Set. International Interactions 42(5).

name: globe.gl
use: Three-dimensional globe, particles, borders and markers.
citation: Asturiano, V. globe.gl, version 2.45.3.

name: Head, Mayer & Ries (2010)
use: Reference result for the erosion curve on Flows of Empire.
citation: Head, K., Mayer, T. and Ries, J. (2010). The erosion of colonial trade linkages after independence. Journal of International Economics 81(1), 1–14.

name: Historical Basemaps
use: Faint historical borders behind the holdings, swapped at 13 snapshot years.
citation: Ourednik, A. historical-basemaps: world borders through history. GitHub repository.
licence: GPL-3.0. Our simplified border files (site/data/borders) are derived works under the same licence.

name: ICOW Colonial History
use: Second cross-check of independence dates and types (Phase 1b).
citation: Hensel, P. R. ICOW Colonial History Data Set, version 1.1.

name: Maddison Project Database
use: Long-run GDP per capita for context in Inherited Systems (Phase 5).
citation: Bolt, J. and van Zanden, J. L. (2024). Maddison style estimates of the evolution of the world economy. Maddison Project Database 2023.

name: National development plans (primary documents)
use: Hand-coded planning regimes and institutions, and the evidence notes in Inherited Systems, drawn from the countries' own plan documents.
citation: e.g. Government of India Planning Commission, First to Twelfth Five-Year Plans; Government of Ghana, Seven-Year Development Plan 1963/64–1969/70; Republic of Indonesia, Repelita I–VI.

name: Natural Earth land (via world-atlas)
use: Land outline from which the dotted earth is generated.
citation: Natural Earth 1:110m land, packaged as world-atlas 2.0.2 (Bostock, M.).
licence: Natural Earth: public domain. world-atlas: ISC.

name: Penn World Table
use: Trade openness and government share of GDP by decade, shown as context in each Inherited Systems file.
citation: Feenstra, R. C., Inklaar, R. and Timmer, M. P. (2015). The Next Generation of the Penn World Table. American Economic Review 105(10). Version 11.0 (2025), national accounts file.
licence: Free for research use with citation (Groningen Growth and Development Centre).

name: RICardo
use: Bilateral trade flows for 1800–1826 on the Territorial Ledger and Flows of Empire.
citation: Dedinger, B. and Girard, P. (2017). Exploring trade globalization in the long run: the RICardo project. Historical Methods 50(1).
licence: Open Database License (ODbL 1.0); contents under the Database Contents License. Our derived 1800–1826 flows in site/data/trade.json are shared under ODbL.

name: TRADHIST (CEPII)
use: Bilateral trade flows for 1827–2014, including colonial entities such as British India and the Straits Settlements.
citation: Fouquin, M. and Hugot, J. (2016). Two Centuries of Bilateral Trade and Gravity Data: 1827–2014. CEPII Working Paper 2016-14.

name: V-Dem
use: State ownership of the economy and institutional context (Phase 5).
citation: Coppedge, M. et al. V-Dem Dataset. Varieties of Democracy Project.

name: Wikidata
use: Links each holding to a stable identifier and cross-checks transfer dates (Phase 1b).
citation: Wikidata contributors. Wikidata, the free knowledge base.

name: World Bank World Development Indicators
use: Post-independence indicators, refreshed monthly by the site's build (Phase 7).
citation: World Bank. World Development Indicators (API v2).

name: UN General Assembly voting data
use: Voting agreement with the former coloniser, the US and the USSR/Russia by decade (Divergence Metrics).
citation: Bailey, M. A., Strezhnev, A. and Voeten, E. (2017). Estimating Dynamic State Preferences from United Nations Voting Data. Journal of Conflict Resolution 61(2). Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/LEJUQZ.

name: La Porta, Lopez-de-Silanes & Shleifer (2008)
use: Legal-origin classification for the curated files.
citation: La Porta, R., Lopez-de-Silanes, F. and Shleifer, A. (2008). The Economic Consequences of Legal Origins. Journal of Economic Literature 46(2), 285–332.

name: Afterempire development codings
use: Planning regime, planning institution and monetary arrangement by decade for 21 countries, with qualitative lineages.
citation: Atal, D. (2026). Afterempire: data/curated/systems_codings.csv (review sheet) and data/curated/lineages.json. Drafted from the sources cited row by row; awaiting review.
